**[P1] Keep polling and API retries on one deadline**

Each of the 900 readiness iterations can now run a separate 10-attempt exponential-backoff loop. With nine throttles followed by success per iteration, this nominally 15-minute poll can take roughly 28 hours; ten consecutive throttles instead abort it early without consuming the readiness budget. The runtime-pin and deletion polls have the same composition. Handle transient read errors within `runWithRetry` and charge them against its existing phase counter, or enforce a shared wall-clock deadline.
